card.tagline: Nepal — traditional dances of the Magar community in Nepal and Sikkim
card.profile: Sorathi dance is a traditional dances of the Magar community in Nepal and Sikkim. It is performed as part of the larger Sorathi folklore, which combines song, music, and storytelling. The dance is believed to be prehistoric and deeply rooted in Magar cultural traditions.
